description: This source file defines Express.js routes for handling HTTP GET requests related to reports. It sets up endpoints for fetching all reports, reports for the current user, and reports associated with a specific team, utilizing a reportsController for handler functions.

methods.name: router.get('/api/reports')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all reports.

methods.name: router.get('/api/reports/mine')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch reports for the current user, filtered via 'x-user-id' header.

methods.name: router.get('/api/teams/:id/reports')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch reports associated with a specific team, identified by team ID in the URL.
